english.title: Fail to comply with police orders in relation to a cordoned area
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[entered, inspected, passed over or under, approached or was in the vicinity of a cordoned area **(..SPECIFY CORDONED AREA..) when ordered not]_
(B)_[caused an unmanned vehicle or device **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE / UNMANNED DEVICE..) to enter, inspect pass over or under, approach or be in the vicinity of a cordoned area **(..SPECIFY CORDONED AREA..), when ordered not]_
(C)_[failed to leave a cordoned area **(..SPECIFY CORDONED AREA..) when ordered]_
(D)_[failed to leave an area adjacent to a cordoned area **(..SPECIFY CORDONED AREA..) when ordered]_
(E)_[failed, as the driver or person in charge of a vehicle or device, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE ETC..) that was in a cordoned area **(..SPECIFY CORDONED AREA..), to move the vehicle or device from the area when ordered]_

to do so by a constable
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(4) and (7) of the National Security Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) Section 11(1) and (3) provide for powers of constables in relation to a cordoned area including the powers to require a person not to carry out specified conduct, such as entering the cordoned area; to require a person to leave a cordoned area immediately; and to arrange for the movement or removal of a vehicle from a cordoned area.
(ii) Section 11(5) provides a defence to this offence where the person can show they had a reasonable excuse for failing to comply with the order of a constable. Reasonable excuse may be demonstrated where sufficient evidence of the matter is adduced to raise an issue with respect to it, and the contrary is not proved beyond reasonable doubt.
